Name: Airbus A320neo
Description: Full startup and procedures checklist for Airbus A320neo.

Steps.Title: Weather Briefing (METAR / TAF / Sigmet)
Steps.Description: Check departure, enroute, destination, and alternate weather.

Steps.Title: NOTAMs
Steps.Description: Check for runway closures, navigation aid outages, and airspace restrictions.

Steps.Title: OFP / SimBrief Flight Plan
Steps.Description: Generate and review Operational Flight Plan - route, fuel, winds, alternates.

Steps.Title: Fuel Planning
Steps.Description: Block fuel includes taxi, trip, contingency (5%), alternate, final reserve (30 min), and extra.

Steps.Title: Weight & Balance / Loadsheet
Steps.Description: Verify ZFW, TOW, and LW are within limits. Check trim setting (CG%).

Steps.Title: SID / STAR / Approach Review
Steps.Description: Review departure and expected arrival procedures. Check transition altitudes.

Steps.Title: MEL / CDL Items
Steps.Description: Review any Minimum Equipment List or Configuration Deviation List items.

Steps.Title: Performance - Takeoff Speeds
Steps.Description: V1, VR, V2, and flex temperature based on TOW, runway, and conditions.

Steps.Title: APU Start
Steps.Description: ON - wait for AVAIL light on ECAM (~1 min).

Steps.Title: ADIRS 1, 2, 3
Steps.Description: NAV - do not move aircraft during alignment (~7 min).

Steps.Title: MCDU - INIT B Page
Steps.Description: ENTER Fuel, ZFW, CG - verify block fuel matches actual.

Steps.Title: MCDU - PERF
Steps.Description: ENTER V1, VR, V2, FLEX Temp.

Steps.Title: Beacon Light
Steps.Description: ON - signal to ground crew that engines will start.

Steps.Title: Pack Switches
Steps.Description: OFF - reduces APU bleed load during engine start.

Steps.Title: Engine Mode Selector
Steps.Description: IGN/START - enables automatic ignition and packs off for engine start.

Steps.Title: Ground Crew
Steps.Description: CLEARED TO START - wait for pushback clearance if required.

Steps.Title: Engine Mode Selector
Steps.Description: NORM - return to NORM after both engines stabilised.

Steps.Title: Pitch Trim
Steps.Description: SET FOR TAKEOFF - check loadsheet for trim value.

Steps.Title: Flight Instruments
Steps.Description: CHECK during taxi - PFD, ND, ECAM.

Steps.Title: Briefing
Steps.Description: CONFIRMED - review departure, SID, engine failure procedures.

Steps.Title: Thrust Levers
Steps.Description: ADVANCE to 50% N1 - stabilise engines before applying takeoff thrust.

Steps.Title: Thrust Levers
Steps.Description: FLX/MCT or TOGA - use FLEX if FLEX temp entered, otherwise TOGA.

Steps.Title: FMA
Steps.Description: VERIFY - MAN FLX (or MAN TOGA), SRS, RWY.

Steps.Title: Rotate at VR
Steps.Description: SMOOTH backstick - pitch 15 deg nose up.

Steps.Title: At S-Speed - Flaps
Steps.Description: RETRACT to 0 - retract incrementally as speed builds: 2 → 1 → 0.

Steps.Title: Fuel Quantity & Balance
Steps.Description: CHECK - monitor fuel burn vs flight plan. Max imbalance ~1,500 kg.

Steps.Title: Flight Progress
Steps.Description: MONITOR on ND / MCDU PROG page.

Steps.Title: Radios
Steps.Description: SET as required for ATC sectors.

Steps.Title: Signs
Steps.Description: AS REQUIRED - seat belt sign ON for turbulence.

Steps.Title: Step Climbs
Steps.Description: AS REQUIRED - consider step climb as fuel burns off.

Steps.Title: ATIS / Airport Information
Steps.Description: OBTAINED - note QNH, wind, runway in use, transition level.

Steps.Title: MCDU - PERF APPR Page
Steps.Description: ENTER QNH, Temp, Wind, Trans LVL, Minimums.

Steps.Title: MCDU - APPR Page
Steps.Description: VERIFY or SELECT approach and runway.

Steps.Title: Approach Briefing
Steps.Description: COMPLETED - review approach chart, minimums, missed approach procedure.

Steps.Title: ILS Frequency
Steps.Description: SET and IDENTIFIED - verify on both PFDs.

Steps.Title: ALT Knob
Steps.Description: PUSH for managed descent - or PULL for open/selected descent.

Steps.Title: Transition Level
Steps.Description: SET local QNH when passing - both PFDs - verify altimeters match.

Steps.Title: LS Button
Steps.Description: ON (both PFDs) - displays ILS localiser and glideslope scales.

Steps.Title: APPR Button on FCU
Steps.Description: PRESS when cleared for approach - arms LOC and G/S modes.

Steps.Title: Speed
Steps.Description: MANAGED - green dot or as assigned.

Steps.Title: Landing Gear
Steps.Description: DOWN - select DOWN when established on localiser or as required.

Steps.Title: Flaps FULL
Steps.Description: SET - CONF FULL for shortest landing distance. CONF 3 if required.

Steps.Title: Cabin Crew
Steps.Description: NOTIFIED - press CALLS ALL for cabin ready confirmation.

Steps.Title: 1,000 ft - Stable Approach
Steps.Description: VERIFY - if not stabilised by 1,000 ft AGL, execute go-around.

Steps.Title: Touchdown
Steps.Description: MAIN GEAR first - hold pitch attitude, lower nose gently.
